behaviouralInsights: Fear signal: 'production dbt... ~1B rows daily' is unusually specific — they hired someone who couldn't handle scale. Must explicitly signal Vinted's data scale.
Fear signal: 'fast-moving environments' + 'ambiguity' repeated — prior hire needed too much direction. Lead with ownership and autonomous decision-making language.
Desire signal: 'set direction for analytics patterns, standards, and strategy' — this is a Staff-level architect role, not an executor. Frame bullets as strategic decisions, not tasks.
Primacy: First JD responsibility is core dbt models — first Vinted bullet must lead here.
Peak-end: First and last Vinted bullets are highest scrutiny. Both must be punchy and metrics-led.
ATS keywords: dbt, incremental models, semantic layer, self-serve analytics, data quality standards, CI/CD, data modeling, custom macros, warehouse performance, cross-domain, metrics, fast-moving.
Absence signal: No Spark, Airflow, Tableau — skip these. Looker = semantic layer match for Omni.
Nice-to-have: Finance and Marketing data — Tourlane and LucaNet roles directly cover this. Surface explicitly.
Culture: Mission-driven Series B startup, remote, autonomy. Mirror 'transparent', 'fair', 'early-stage' framing subtly.

Loss aversion: 'Balance speed, accuracy, and maintainability' and 'establish data quality standards' are fear signals — a prior bad hire likely shipped fast but broke things. Frame achievements as quality and maintainability wins alongside scale.
adaptationNotes: Summary rewritten to lead with production dbt at scale and semantic layer — the two non-negotiables. 'Staff' IC framing: set direction, not just execute.
Vinted first bullet: reframed around dbt production architecture and incremental models at scale — directly addresses the ~1B rows fear signal.
Vinted last bullet: ends with autonomous governance impact (€1.6m recovery) — strong peak-end close.
Tourlane: data bootcamp bullet and Looker semantic layer bullet moved to top — maps to self-serve analytics and data literacy responsibilities.
LucaNet: Finance data experience surfaced as nice-to-have match. 'Defining metrics with business stakeholders' is directly evidenced.
Community: trimmed to 1 bullet each — startup hiring managers scan fast, volunteering is low priority here.
Skills: dbt + SQL first, semantic layer (Looker) second, CI/CD third. Spark/Airflow deprioritised — not in JD.
